rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by ACPE (credit hour = 60 minutes of instruction)
rules.new_licensee_rule: A licensee who graduated from an ACPE-accredited pharmacy school within one year of the first renewal period is exempt from CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; random audit after the renewal period, proof due within 60 days of notice.
rules.notes: CE due before Dec 31 of every odd-numbered year. Board may extend the deadline for illness, military service, geographic isolation or hardship (request before expiry). Based on the Board CE FAQ (April 2015); statute page could not be opened.
